### `GET /api/projects/{project_id}/timeline`

**Get Timeline**

Tree-ordered timeline (priority.md P32). Joins RunEvents by project + parent/run pointer; returns one compact summary node per run_id with children nested. Filters: since, until, stage, severity, run_id (anchor on a subtree).
